headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 11, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Jared Young leading the Cardinals' offense. The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 11-0 victory, led by Colt Keith's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Tyler Phillips earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Detroit Tigers shortstop Javier Báez, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain. Other injured players include Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith, Texas Rangers left-hander Jalen Beeks, Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz, Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero, Los Angeles Angels right-hander Jack Kochanowicz, Kansas City Royals center fielder Kyle Isbel, and Seattle Mariners right-hander Matt Brash.

The Philadelphia Phillies have bolstered their outfield with the addition of center fielder Dylan Campbell and second baseman Jose Colmenares, acquired in a trade with the Chicago White Sox. The Detroit Tigers have also acquired right-hander Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 11-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a convincing 11-0 victory. Colt Keith led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Diamondbacks 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Tyler Phillips earning the win after 5.0 innings of work, striking out 5 batters and allowing 2 hits.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Royals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Corey Seager leading the offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Beck Way impressed in relief, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Javier Báez Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers shortstop Javier Báez has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Acquire Outfield Depth in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have bolstered their outfield with the addition of CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares, acquired in a trade with the Chicago White Sox.
